source_text: The Montagu Resolution's inclusion of male procedures sets it apart, as evidenced by debates in peer-reviewed analyses questioning moral equivalence due to differing health data—FGM linked to severe complications like hemorrhage (up to 15% in some types) versus male circumcision's lower risks but contested benefits like HIV reduction (60% efficacy in adult trials per WHO, 2007).
